items.title: Willy Adames: 2+ home runs?
items.notes: Smoke test estimate; not a real trade thesis
items.rulesPrimary: If Willy Adames records 2+ home runs in San Francisco vs Los Angeles D professional baseball game originally scheduled for May 11, 2026 at 10:10 PM EDT, then the market resolves to Yes.
items.rulesSecondary:
Player Participation & Settlement Criteria
If Willy Adames is scratched or not included in the starting lineup, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Willy Adames starts the game but does not record a plate appearance, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Willy Adames is not in the starting lineup but later enters the game, the market will resolve to the fair market price, pinch hit at bats will not count towards the market.
If Willy Adames is in the starting lineup and records at least one plate appearance the market will settle based on home runs recorded.
items.biggestRisk: Manual estimate may be wrong; verify evidence and resolution rules before any paper/live trade.
